validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/DUPLICATE/ATTRIBUTION all confirmed with THREE independent, mutually-corroborating first-party sources -- this is one of the more solidly-documented rows in the batch, not a GEM-only entity. (1) gem.wiki's own cited India Investment Grid (IIG, Govt of India) project page (https://indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in/opportunities/nip-project/701231, url_verifier OK on Haridwar/Dehradun/Rishikesh) fetched and read in full: project 'Haridwar-Rishikesh-Dehradun Pipeline Project', promoter type Central PSU, status 'Completion Certificate/COD', start date 10-Aug-2018, completion date 30-Jun-2023, cost USD 20.12 million. The row's existing_ref_check flagged this URL as 'value not found (operating)' because it checks for the literal string -- IIG's actual status label is 'Completion Certificate/COD', which is semantically operating (COD = commercial operation date) and directly supports StartYear1=2023 (matches exactly) and Status=operating. This is a false-negative on wording, not a broken/unsupported ref. (2) gem.wiki's own second cited source, the Uttarakhand Environment Protection & Pollution Control Board (UEPPCB, state govt) EIA Executive Summary, is genuinely independent of IIG (different govt body, different document type -- a 2021 pre-construction environmental filing vs a 2024 investment-tracking status page). The LIVE URL (https://ueppcb.uk.gov.in/files/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_2.pdf) currently fails DNS resolution from this environment and, per the Wayback CDX index, the same URL path was overwritten with an unrelated Bageshwar soapstone-mining EIA by Dec-2023 (a live-URL content-drift trap, not evidence the pipeline doc never existed) -- so I pulled the correct pre-overwrite snapshot from the Wayback Machine (digest JUTYM6EUMO5JOWEZK6DAJTMOG5XRMIOG, consistent across 2022-03, 2022-06 x2 and 2025-05 crawls, i.e. genuinely the long-lived pipeline document): https://web.archive.org/web/20220302210841/https://ueppcb.uk.gov.in/files/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_2.pdf. url_verifier passed once cleanly on Haridwar+Dehradun then timed out on repeat large-PDF fetches (network flakiness, not a content problem); read in full locally with pdftotext -layout. It is titled 'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY FOR LAYING OF NATURAL GAS TRANSPORTATION PIPELINE FOR HARIDWAR-RISHIKESH-DEHRADUN PIPELINE SECTION', proponent 'GAIL (India) Limited', prepared by Mantec Consultants (Feb 2021): 8'' NB pipeline, 50 km (approx), Design Gas Flow 1.2 MMSCMD, Dispatch Station at Jwalapur (Haridwar district, tapped off GAIL's existing Saharanpur-Haridwar Pipeline), Receipt Station in Dehradun district, with SV-02 at Ch24+625 explicitly noted as a 'Tap OFF for Rishikesh' -- i.e. Rishikesh is served via a mid-route tap, not an endpoint, which is fully consistent with the sheet's Haridwar/Dehradun endpoint fields and the compound pipeline name. Design pressure 98 barg, PIG launcher/receiver at both ends, 3 sectionalizing-valve stations -- classic transmission-trunk engineering, confirming PipelineType=transmission is correct (this is not a CGD distribution network; Haridwar Natural Gas Pvt Ltd's separate CGD steel/MDPE network, checked at https://hngpl.in/pipeline-network/, is a distinct downstream system fed from the different, shorter Saharanpur-Haridwar Pipeline -- no overlap/duplicate risk). (3) A third, independent regulator document -- PNGRB's own Integrated Natural Gas Pipeline tariff order dated 22-Mar-2023 (https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/orders/INGPL_TO_22032023.pdf; url_verifier FAILs 'missing expected' on this large multi-column PDF, the same documented false-negative pattern flagged for the NGPL MIS report in the scope guidance -- confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout) explicitly discusses 'Haridwar-Rishikesh-Dehradun Pipeline Project'/'HRDPL' by name multiple times as a GAIL capex line item under PNGRB review (Rs 14.36 Cr FY2022-23 + Rs 44.45 Cr FY2023-24 future PE capex, Board-approved), i.e. the pipeline regulator itself, independently of GAIL's own EIA filing, confirms the project's existence, name and GAIL ownership as of March 2023 -- consistent with the IIG completion date of Jun-2023. DUPLICATE check: searched the full live GGIT gas snapshot for Haridwar/Rishikesh/Dehradun/Saharanpur -- P3906 is the only row that matches; no hidden duplicate or relabel. As expected per the scope guidance, this dedicated GAIL tap-off line does NOT appear itemized in the current PNGRB monthly line-wise NGPL-MIS report (20260531 edition, checked) -- consistent with it being a dedicated/tie-in line outside the common-carrier itemization, not an existence red flag.
